summary: The root مأي (mAy) primarily signifies the act of drawing water from a well. It can also refer to the water itself, or the place where water is drawn.

headwords.def: (like مَاءَ ) It (a cat) mewed. (TA, voce مَاءَ, art. موأ.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
